modules.title: 错误密码怎样经过一条完整测试用例
一条用例需要留下什么

items.title: 先给出相同的起点和动作
items.text: 写明账号状态、输入值和点击步骤，别人才能复现同一情形。自动化测试也需要稳定的准备与操作，而不是依赖上一次残留的数据。

items.title: 预期结果要能与实际结果相比
items.text: 用例不只记录“测试过”。它应写清应该看到什么，再保留实际看到的页面、接口结果或失败信息，方便定位差异。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 测试用例不是整个测试计划。计划会安排范围、角色和时间；单个用例只描述一次具体检查。它也不保证所有风险都被覆盖，需要与验收标准和风险判断一起使用。

lessonPractice.title: 下面哪段最像可执行的“错误密码”测试用例？

options.label: 准备已注册账号，输入正确邮箱和错误密码；点登录；预期留在登录页并显示“密码不正确”
options.feedback: 对。起点、输入、动作和预期结果齐全，别人可以重复执行。

options.label: 准备已注册账号，依次尝试几组密码，记录登录页出现的结果
options.feedback: 它有准备和操作，但没有写明这次检查期待什么结果，执行者无法直接判断通过或失败。

options.label: 输入任意邮箱和错误密码；点登录；预期统一显示“密码不正确”
options.feedback: 邮箱是否属于已注册账号会改变合理结果；起点不明确时，这条预期可能把“账号不存在”也误判成密码错误。

en.title: Which text most resembles an executable wrong-password test case?

options.label: Prepare a registered account, enter its email and a wrong password, sign in, and expect to remain on the login page with “incorrect password”
options.feedback: Correct. It has a starting point, input, action, and expected result that someone else can repeat.

options.label: Prepare a registered account, try several passwords, and record whatever the login page shows
options.feedback: It has setup and actions but no expected result, so the executor cannot directly decide pass or fail.

options.label: Enter any email and a wrong password, sign in, and always expect “incorrect password”
options.feedback: Whether the email belongs to a registered account can change the valid result. The starting condition is too vague for that expectation.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为错误密码登录补一条测试用例：写清准备条件、输入、操作和预期结果。实现后按这条用例实际操作一次，确认不会进入账户页且错误提示清楚。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a wrong-password login test case with preconditions, input, action, and expected result. After implementation, actually run it once and confirm it does not enter the account page and the error is clear.

learning.assumes: You know a page can have success and failure results.
learning.outcome: You can write a test case another person can execute and compare with its expected result.

modules.title: How a wrong password travels through one full test case
What one case needs to retain

items.title: Give the same starting point and action
items.text: State the account condition, input, and clicks so another person can reproduce the situation. Automation also needs stable preparation, not data left from a prior run.

items.title: Compare expectation with reality
items.text: A case does not merely say “tested.” It records what should appear and what actually appeared, including a page, response, or failure information when useful.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A test case is not a complete test plan. A plan assigns scope, people, and time; one case describes one concrete check. It also cannot cover every risk by itself.

distinctions.label: Acceptance criteria
distinctions.text: A {c:test-case} is one repeatable check. {c:acceptance-criteria} are the conditions stakeholders use to decide whether the result is acceptable.
